meta_description: Welcome to Daily Islam - Preview for Android.
full_description: • Preview the latest features: Try out the newest features.• Give early feedback: Let us know what you think and help make Daily Islam for Android a better Islamic educational platform.You can install Daily Islam - Preview alongside other channels of Daily Islam for Android.Features:The Prophet (PBUH) said, “Convey (my teachings) to the people even if it were a single sentence. ….. And whoever tells a lie on me intentionally, will surely take his place in the (Hell) Fire.Sahih al-Bukhari: 3461The Daily Islam is an online-based educational platform to help users build smart Islamic Lifestyles and gain true knowledge of Islam.Daily Islam is extremely diligent about the said message of our beloved Prophet (PBUH). We always will try to publish the True and Correct information on Islamic Lifestyle in the light of the Holy Quran and Sunnah.Our objectives are:• To spread true Islamic knowledge to the people, especially younger generations,• To unearth the real information based on Quran and Sahih Hadith on all questions that are answered in vague or confusing ways, or in other scenarios, given multiple contradictory answers• To help understand the alternatives of each practice in Islam• To assist people to understand that Islamic Lifestyle is Simple, Smart and Rewarding• To give emphasis on family education• To unearth misconceptions rooted in the society in the name of Islam• To work for increasing unity in the community• To eradicate poverty using Zakat under Project Permanent Solution of Poverty(PPSP)Areas we are working:• Working in Multiple Language, initially in Bangla, English and Arabic.• Holy Quran in 30 languages including our own translation and voice in Bangla• Hadith – working for Daily Islam’s own database in major languages for all Hadith Books• 5 Pillars – Research based, comparative information with helpful illustrations• Dua – having all relevant categories with appropriate references• Lifestyle – Contents cover Islamic History, Events of Life, Family Education• Prayer time, alerts on different issues (such as prayer times, Ramadan Planner, iftar and sahri, Islamic events, daily tips and Hadiths)• Books – Thousands of Islamic books• Project Permanent Solution (PPS) to eradicate povertyOur Approach• Completeness of the subject matter – we try to cover all probable aspects of a subject in question• Research based Content – all contents are based on vigorous and accurate researchCo-research• As-Sunnah Trust• As-Sunnah FoundationC O N N E C T
